decisions.summary: seat_cluster's HARD 1 (no seat below the drain) removed for every form; below_drain judged within the drain's span across the slope; the per-farm rule no seat enforced filed E3 (found-wave15.jsonl)
decisions.why: Literal to 0058's drawing page (unedited since feature 303): 'Farmhouses are kept off the ground below a drain only in a dispersed settlement, not in a nucleated cluster' and 'each farm of a dispersed settlement ... must stand on dry ground on its own', and to row 404's fix ('drop HARD 1'). HARD 1 tested the seat margin's midpoint, never a farmstead, so keeping it at a dispersed seat would enforce a rule the page does not state - an 'X except Y' - rather than the per-farm rule; filing that rule as a new ranked row (E3, a new placement rule across modules) puts it in the queue the request asks to work through.
